signature: A spotless remodelled Level 0 office suite (dry red carpet, white walls, working outlets and Wi-Fi, a bathroom) that comes apart around you once you enter: ceilings swing down, wall sheets topple and the floor sags, exposing the bare framing of an unfinished house, until the chain reaction stops at the door back to Level 0.

exits.label: Opened the old door back to Level 0
exits.source_quote: The level can be exited the same way it is entered, finding a door will lead back to Level 0.
exits.hint: Past the end of the hall, one door in the lobby is older than everything else here. Yellow light and a familiar buzz leak under it.

fail_states.label: Crushed by falling ceiling panels during the collapse
fail_states.source_quote: the debris can collapse on top of them

fail_states.label: Choked on the plaster dust that follows
fail_states.source_quote: the dust afterward can be very dangerous

entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE. Backrooms Remodelling Co. staff (Major Took, Cap'n, the four-person crew) exist only as authors and addressees of the clipboard documents; nobody is spawned.
notes: SOURCE: sub-section between Level 0 and Level 1 created by Backrooms Remodelling Co.; untouched it looks like a revamped Level 0 with dry red carpets, repainted white walls, consistently working Wi-Fi and outlets and the occasional bathroom; on entering it falls apart (ceiling tiles fall, walls topple, the floor collapses) revealing what looks like an unfinished house; debris and the dust afterwards are dangerous; the destruction stops when the chain reaction reaches the door back to Level 0 and the level is completely fixed on re-entry; whether the collapse is deliberate is unknown; no bases; recovered clipboard documents 1-3 (slogan, job order, torn reply). ADAPTATION: the floor plan (3 m grid, 27 x 36 m: reception, hall, lobby, open-plan office, bathroom, crew storage room, conference room, file room, break room, sunken lounge, foreman's site office, small office, utility room) is ours, as are the sunken lounge (three 0.18 m risers; the page gives no geometry), the drop ceiling, the crawlspace under the deck and the joists above the ceiling (our reading of 'an unfinished house'); the collapse arms after you walk 4 m in or touch anything and runs from the entrance toward the lobby door at 0.85 m/s, stopping at the door; ceiling panels hinge down or drop, about 40% of wall sheets topple (studs and the far sheet keep the wall solid), nine seeded floor cells sag into a walkable valley; falling ceiling 22 damage, dust fog with slow health loss; the new door you entered by stays shut (the page names only a door back to Level 0 as the way out); the old door's yellow light and buzz are our cue for Level 0 behind it. Reset on re-entry is the scene reload. Not built: any Level 1 exit (none stated). Seeds vary door positions, collapse flags, sagging cells and furniture.
